Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane has scored in 10 consecutive UEFA Champions League matches, moving within one game of Cristiano Ronaldo’s record of 11 successive scoring appearances. The English striker scored from the spot to give Bayern the lead at the Allianz Arena on Wednesday before Declan Rice whipped an equaliser for the visiting London club, Arsenal. According to UEFA on Wednesday, Kane achieved the feat with his goal against Arsenal on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, during Matchday Three of the 2026/27 Champions League league phase. The England captain became the second player to score in 10 consecutive matches in the competition, joining Ronaldo, who holds the record with an 11-game scoring streak for Real Madrid across the 2017/18 campaign. Add us to your Preferred Sources Kane had previously been level with former Manchester United striker Ruud van Nistelrooy and Poland international Robert Lewandowski, who each scored in nine consecutive Champions League matches. Lewandowski achieved the feat twice while playing for Bayern Munich, during the 2019/20 and 2020/21 campaigns. Ronaldo’s record run began with two goals in Real Madrid’s 4-1 victory over Juventus in the 2017 Champions League final. UCL: Mbappe inspires Madrid to 4-1 win, Arsenal hold Bayern 2-2 UCL: Nico Paz shines as Como thrash Man United 4-1 UCL: Osimhen scores as Galatasaray beat Lille 4-2 The Portuguese forward subsequently scored in all six group-stage matches of the 2017/18 season and found the net in both legs of Real Madrid’s round-of-16 tie against Paris Saint-Germain and quarter-final encounter with Juventus. He scored 17 goals during the 11-match run, according to UEFA. The record for consecutive Champions League scoring appearances is led by Ronaldo with 11 matches, followed by Kane with 10. Van Nistelrooy and Lewandowski are joint third with nine matches each, while Ronaldo also recorded an eight-match streak in 2013/14. UEFA’s statistics cover matches from the group stage or league phase through to the final. Full list of longest Champions League scoring streaks Cristiano Ronaldo — 11 consecutive matches (2017/18) Harry Kane — 10 consecutive matches (2026–present) Ruud van Nistelrooy — 9 consecutive matches (2002/03) Robert Lewandowski — 9 consecutive matches (2019/20) Robert Lewandowski — 9 consecutive matches (2020/21) Cristiano Ronaldo — 8 consecutive matches (2013/14) Tosin Oyediran Tosin Oyediran is a journalist with Punch Newspapers, bringing over eight years of newsroom experience to his coverage of politics, health, advocacy, sports, and entertainment.
